title: AntiEscape
description: Anti Escape, which allows players to be controlled by authorities
body:
**AntiEscape - Advanced Minecraft Player Control & Security Plugin**

**WHAT IS ANTIESCAPE?**

AntiEscape is a comprehensive Minecraft server management plugin designed to give server administrators complete control over players while maintaining server security. It's the ultimate solution for servers that need to manage player behavior, prevent rule violations, and maintain order through advanced control mechanisms.

**MAIN PURPOSE:**

The primary purpose of AntiEscape is to provide server staff with powerful tools to:
- Take control of problematic players
- Restrict player movements and actions
- Monitor suspicious activities
- Automatically ban rule violators
- Maintain detailed logs of all player actions
- Integrate with Discord for real-time notifications

**WHY DO YOU NEED ANTIESCAPE?**

If you're running a Minecraft server, you've likely encountered situations where:
- Players break rules and need immediate intervention
- Staff members need to investigate player behavior
- You want to prevent players from escaping punishment
- You need comprehensive logging for moderation purposes
- You want to automate security responses

AntiEscape solves all these problems with an intuitive, feature-rich system that integrates seamlessly with your existing server setup.

**KEY FEATURES:**

**CORE CONTROL SYSTEM**
- Player Control: Take complete control of any player instantly
- Movement Prevention: Block all player movements, teleports, and actions
- Command Blocking: Prevent controlled players from using commands
- Chat Control: Isolated control chat system for staff communication
- Item Drop Prevention: Stop controlled players from dropping items
- Damage Protection: Protect controlled players from attacks
- Self-Control Prevention: Players cannot control themselves

**ADVANCED CONTROL SYSTEM**
- Session Management: Track control sessions with timestamps
- Control History: Complete history of all control actions
- Player Notes: Add and manage notes for each player
- Statistics: Track escape attempts and suspicious activities
- Time Limits: Set maximum control duration with auto-release
- Escape Tracking: Record when players quit during control

**ADVANCED SECURITY SYSTEM**
- IP Address Control: Monitor and restrict IP addresses
- VPN/Proxy Detection: Detect and block VPN connections
- Suspicious Activity: Monitor rapid movements, commands, and chat
- Auto-Ban System: Automatic banning for security violations
- Whitelist System: Bypass security checks for trusted players
- Security Logging: Comprehensive security event logging
- Ban Escalation: Increase ban duration for repeat offenders

**COMPREHENSIVE LOGGING SYSTEM**
- Separate Log Files: Different log files for each event type
- Configurable Logging: Enable/disable specific log types
- Log Rotation: Automatic log file rotation and compression
- Event Types: Moves, commands, chat, damage, items, control, general
- Detailed Information: Timestamps, player info, location data

**DISCORD INTEGRATION**
- Webhook System: Send notifications to Discord channels
- Customizable Embeds: Fully customizable embed messages
- Event Notifications: Control start/end, escapes, movements, commands
- Rich Formatting: Custom colors, thumbnails, fields, and footers
- Async Processing: Non-blocking webhook delivery

**MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT**
- English & Turkish: Full language support with easy switching
- Configurable Messages: All messages customizable via language files
- Easy Localization: Simple structure for adding new languages
- Auto-Generation: Language files created automatically

**COMMAND OVERVIEW:**
**MAIN COMMANDS**
- /control help - Show help menu
- /control take <player> - Take control of a player
- /control end <player> [ban] - End control or ban player
- /control chat <join/leave> - Join/leave control chat

**LOCATION COMMANDS**
- /control set area - Set control area
- /control set return - Set return location
- /control delete area - Delete control area
- /control delete spawn - Delete return location

**ADVANCED COMMANDS**
- /control history <player> - Show control history
- /control notes <add/clear/list> <player> - Manage player notes
- /control stats <player> - Show player statistics

**SECURITY COMMANDS**
- /control whitelist <add/remove> <player> [reason] - Manage whitelist
- /control suspicious <player> [clear] - Check suspicious activity
- /control violations <player> [clear] - Check violation count
- /control ip <ip> [player] - Check IP information

**SYSTEM COMMANDS**
- /control logs <list/clear/clear-all> - Manage log files
- /control discord test - Test Discord webhook
- /control reload - Reload configuration
- /control version - Show plugin information

**WHY CHOOSE ANTIESCAPE?**
AntiEscape stands out from other control plugins because it offers:
- Complete player control without limitations
- Advanced security monitoring
- Comprehensive logging system
- Discord integration
- Multi-language support
- Regular updates and support
- Professional-grade features
- Easy configuration and use

**CONCLUSION:**
AntiEscape is more than just a player control plugin - it's a comprehensive server management solution that gives you complete control over your Minecraft server. Whether you're running a small community server or a large network, AntiEscape provides the tools you need to maintain order, enforce rules, and protect your players.

With its advanced features, easy-to-use interface, and comprehensive functionality, AntiEscape is the ultimate choice for server administrators who demand the best in player control and security management.

Download AntiEscape today and take control of your server like never before!
